verdict.rationale: Orrick Tech Studio documents its own free, self-serve set of 50+ customizable forms and document generators. These include interactive form pages such as the Convertible Note Financing Term Sheet Creator and the German Incorporation Questionnaire, plus a GenAI Policy Builder that creates a draft policy, and a community user confirms wizards like the term sheet generator. However, the evidence never details the guided-assembly flow, its depth, or what finished output a founder gets, and the policy tool produces only a draft. Missing for 10: documentation of the step-by-step interactive assembly and the completed-document output (download/export), hands-on independent corroboration of generating a complete executable document online, and clarity on how many of the 50+ items are true generators rather than static templates.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm ships self-serve document automation — interactive assembly of real legal documents I can complete online, not just static templates
